description: Czech-language nutrition tracking from kaloricketabulky.cz: food/activity/recipe search with full macro breakdown, daily diary, weight log, and 10 transcendence features powered by a local SQLite cache.

tools.name: activity_search
tools.description: Search activities by text (e.g. 'běh', 'plavání', 'joga'). Required: query. Optional: page, format (default: json). Returns array of ActivityMatch.

tools.name: find_all
tools.description: One search across all entity types. Required: query. Optional: page, format (default: json). Returns array of SearchHit.

tools.name: food_search
tools.description: Search foods by Czech text (diacritics-tolerant on server). Required: query. Optional: page, format (default: json). Returns array of FoodstuffMatch.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query (Czech name like 'jablko', 'tvaroh'); minimum 3 chars

tools.name: recipe_search
tools.description: Search recipes by text. Required: query. Optional: page, format (default: json). Returns array of RecipeMatch.

tools.name: stats_diary_count
tools.description: Total diary entries across all users. Optional: format (default: json). Returns the CountEnvelope.

tools.name: stats_foodstuff_count
tools.description: Total foods in the catalog. Optional: format (default: json). Returns the CountEnvelope.

tools.name: stats_user_count
tools.description: Total registered users. Optional: format (default: json). Returns the CountEnvelope.
